flags: Nudge Security's third-party profile claims SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI, FedRamp, and CSA STAR certifications, but none of these are mentioned on Compose AI's official website, so they cannot be verified from the vendor's own sources.

The privacy policy addresses only US privacy laws (CCPA, Nevada). Despite an international user base, there is no mention of GDPR, EU data protection, Data Processing Agreements, or Standard Contractual Clauses.

The privacy policy does not disclose whether user-submitted text trains the AI model. The homepage claims personalization 'learns your voice,' implying some form of model training, but no opt-out mechanism is documented.
No public Data Processing Agreement or vendor Data Protection Addendum is available; this document is essential for EU customers.
The company operates under US law only, with no regional compliance posture for international markets.
The company remains at seed-stage funding ($2.22M, 2021); no Series A or later rounds in 5 years suggests capital constraints for compliance and security investments.
